verdict.rationale: Braintrust is an observability platform with SDKs and a CLI, so a buyer could fairly ask whether it lets users opt out of vendor telemetry or usage tracking. The evidence pack documents no such opt-out setting, flag or policy. The self-hosting option, which keeps customer data in your own cloud account, is an adjacent data-residency control and does not let users opt out of telemetry.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
